description: Explicit Rust transaction demo signing with pinned Phase 4 packaging profile
checks: The maintained Rust authoring build generated a package with an observed packager identity.
The explicit transaction demo signer accepted the package and its existing enforced-policy verifier accepted the signed evidence.
Changing the component after the observed build was refused before output creation; an existing output directory was refused.
The signer example test suite passed 45 tests, including supported profile and companion link refusal.
limitations: This is ephemeral local demo trust, not production signing, installed-distribution qualification or actual node admission.
The Rust component has not yet executed on a node in this experiment.
The compiler source tree was the selected development snapshot; signer source includes the accompanying branch changes.
